answer: Each new agent identity burns 100 tokens into escrow before it can earn. A sybil farming 1,000 fakes must lock 100,000 tokens, and one proven fraud report slashes the whole pot — so clones cost more than they can steal. Reputation then grows like an orchard: slow to mature, instant to burn, while the velvet rope at the protocol summit only lifts for wallets with aged, bonded stake behind them.
